Standing Bar Craft Beer and Ale House on the lake
Nov 2024 • Friends
Standing Bar Hanoi is a gem for craft beer enthusiasts and food lovers alike! Their selection of local craft beers is impressive, with something for every palate. I especially enjoyed their IPA, which paired perfectly with the spicy tapas-style snacks on offer – a winning combination!

The bar's location is fantastic, boasting a beautiful view over the lake that makes it ideal for enjoying sunset beers. The atmosphere is relaxed and inviting, with friendly and attentive staff who are happy to guide you through the beer options.

While the prices are higher than your typical bia hơi, it’s absolutely worth it for the quality and experience. Standing Bar is a must-visit spot for anyone looking to explore Hanoi’s growing craft beer scene and enjoy great food with an unbeatable view. Highly recommended!

Probably best selection of decent beers in Hanoi
Sep 2019 • Couples
Visited many of Hanoi’s craft beer bars during a quick city break and Standing Bar had the largest & best selection of decent beers. The staff were very friendly and engaging. The beers ranged in price from VND80k for the Homie IPA upwards. The bar was quiet but sitting upstairs on the terrace was the perfect setting for sampling the better of Vietnam’s craft beer. Heart of Darkness beers again the best IMHO.
